depicted_variant: The old woman of the white mare, midnight Medo apparition
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Medo, the old woman of the white mare, a terrifying midnight apparition in Algarve [medo-c01,c06,c07].
ANATOMY: ONE elderly female rider with ONE human head, TWO eyes, TWO arms, TWO legs, fully opaque rough dark cloak and ankle-length dress; ONE living white mare with ONE horse head, TWO eyes, TWO ears and FOUR horse legs, ordinary horse anatomy, no horns or wings [medo-c06,c07]. Rider's old angular face half-shadowed, fierce direct stare and tight grim mouth. No witch hat, magical staff, skeleton anatomy or invented spectral transparent body.
MOMENT: CHARGE STRAIGHT DOWN toward the viewer at midnight: white mare rears into a surging forward gallop at extremely close range, two forehooves thrust forward clearly separate, hind legs kicking dust below, rider bent forward gripping mane with both hands and glaring down. Whipped cloak and mane, wide nostrils and open horse mouth express the documented infernal din. The rider and horse dominate, not picturesque countryside [medo-c06,c07].
POWER: No depicted magic, aura or supernatural beams; the frightening rushing apparition and hoofbeat dust convey the midnight terror and infernal din of the account [medo-c06,c07].
SCALE & CAMERA: ground-level extreme low angle immediately in front of oncoming mare, horse head and rider face large and clear, forehooves bottom foreground. No giant size.
LIGHT & WEATHER: One hard full moon from side illuminates chalk-white horse face, old woman's tense face and dust edges; deep walnut shadows and high contrast. Fine summer moonlit night [medo-c03,c06].
SURFACE: tactile rough white horse coat, damp nostrils, tangled mane, weathered opaque cloth, dry dusty earth.
SETTING: Empty Algarve fields at the stroke of midnight, low field wall and distant small olive silhouettes, field horizon kept narrow [medo-c02,c03,c06,c07].
MOOD: immediately threatening galloping midnight apparition, never ordinary peaceful woman on a horse; fear through aggressive framing and action, not invented anatomy.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, pseudoletters, logo, border, watermark, gore or nudity; no extra heads, limbs or digits; no copyrighted film/game/anime/comic design; no generic glowing aura, neon outlines, energy ribbons or floating runes.

visual_requirements.description: Old woman riding a white mare
Rides with infernal din as terror of midnight; no invented magic
Algarve fields on moonlit summer night at midnight

aura: No generic aura. Presence comes from documented anatomy and action: medo-c06, medo-c07, medo-c02, medo-c03.
artistic_choices: Selected old woman of white mare account, not iron-hatted man or red-cap variant.
Opaque dark cloak/dress, dry dust, field wall and low camera editorial. No giant size or ghost transparency; documented action carries threat.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: Native1254 and200px inspected. One fierce elderly rider in fully opaque dark cloak/dress, two boots straddling one white mare. One horse head/two ears/two eyes, two distinct forelegs thrust at viewer with hind legs behind/partly occluded in gallop, no duplicate head or extra limbs. Tight ground-level charge, hoofbeat dust, flowing mane and challenging face convey midnight terror c06/c07 at200. Algarve field context, moonlight, no invented spectral anatomy or magical effect. No aura, text or gore. Seven Sangar checks pass; documented human/horse appearance relies on aggressive action and framing.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and the rider's face, rein-hand, boots and forehoof crops. This is the old woman of the white mare (medo-c06/c07). One elderly woman has one head and two eyes, long grey hair, and a deeply lined, glaring face under a ragged black hood. Her fully opaque, tattered dark cloak and dress whip behind her. One gnarled hand grips the reins and mane (thumb plus four, normal), and a boot shows on each side of the horse, so two legs. One white mare charges straight at a ground-level camera. It has one head, two ears, two eyes, flared nostrils and an open mouth (the infernal din, c06). Its two forehooves thrust into the foreground and throw clods and dust; the hind legs are hidden behind in the gallop, with no extra limbs. Bridle and reins are ordinary tack. A full moon over Algarve fields with dry-stone walls and olive trees (c02/c03/c06/c07). No spectral transparency, magic, text or aura. At 200px the charging mass and the crone's glare make a terrifying midnight rider, not an ordinary woman out riding.
